name: Tetris
description: Classic Tetris with NES-style speed levels: place the falling pieces to complete and clear rows. A Phaser 3 game from the Phaser examples gallery.
goal: Tetris. Pieces fall into a 10-column well. Left and Right arrows move the falling piece, X rotates it clockwise and Z counter-clockwise, holding Down drops it faster. A completely filled row clears. The game ends when the pieces stack up to the top. Clear as many rows as you can.

perception.read: (() => { const g = window.__ibgamer && window.__ibgamer.phaser && window.__ibgamer.phaser.game(); const s = g && g.scene && g.scene.getScene('inGame'); if (!s || !g.scene.isActive('inGame') || !s.table || !s.piece) { return { playing: false }; } const p = s.piece; const board = s.table.colorsArray.map((r) => r.map((v) => (v ? 1 : 0))); p.frame.forEach((row, ry) => row.forEach((v, rx) => { if (!v) { return; } const q = p.localToTable(rx, ry); if (board[q.y] && board[q.y][q.x] !== undefined) { board[q.y][q.x] = 0; } })); return { playing: !s.isGameOver, board, piece: { type: p.type, rotation: p.rotation, x: p.x, y: p.y, frame: p.frame }, next: s.pieceQueue.next, level: s.table.level, lines: s.table.lines }; })()
perception.format: { playing, board: rows of 10 cells (1 = settled block, 0 = empty; the falling piece is not in it), piece: { type (1 O, 2 T, 3 Z, 4 S, 5 J, 6 L, 7 I), rotation, x, y, frame: the piece's cells as rows of 0/1 in its current rotation }, next: the next piece's type, level, lines } — { playing: false } until a game is on.

score.expression: (() => { const g = window.__ibgamer && window.__ibgamer.phaser && window.__ibgamer.phaser.game(); const s = g && g.scene && g.scene.getScene('inGame'); if (!s || !g.scene.isActive('inGame') || !s.table) { return { over: false, score: 0 }; } return { over: !!s.isGameOver, score: s.table.lines, points: s.score, level: s.table.level }; })()
score.label: rows cleared
